title: Reading Drill — Making a Beach Guide Useful
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Making a Beach Guide Useful
passages.body:
**A** A coastal town produced a beach guide with photos taken at high tide. People who arrived later asked why the water was so far from the lifeguard tower shown in the pictures.

**B** Designers added photographs taken at different tides and used the tower as a reference point. They also included a scale bar to make distances easier to judge on a phone.

**C** The guide gave the beach office's number but avoided promising staffed hours for every day. It linked to a board which volunteers updated when conditions changed.

questions.prompt: People who arrived later asked why the water was so far from the ______ shown in the pictures.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: People who arrived later asked why the water was so far from the lifeguard tower shown in the pictures.

questions.prompt: They also included a ______ to make distances easier to judge on a phone.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: They also included a scale bar to make distances easier to judge on a phone.

questions.prompt: It linked to a board which volunteers updated when ______ changed.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: It linked to a board which volunteers updated when conditions changed.

questions.prompt: The guide contained photographs of the same beach at more than one tide level.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: Designers added photographs taken at different tides and used the tower as a reference point. They also included a scale bar to make distances easier to judge on a phone.

questions.prompt: Which paragraph mentions why the guide used a source that could be updated quickly?
questions.explanation: The guide gave the beach office's number but avoided promising staffed hours for every day. It linked to a board which volunteers updated when conditions changed.
